verdicts.label: SCAM
verdicts.what_is_true_en: The Indian government is not offering a free three-month mobile recharge scheme. Messages and videos promoting this are part of a recurring scam designed to steal personal data.
verdicts.reasoning_en: Numerous fact-checking organizations and the Indian government's Press Information Bureau (PIB) have repeatedly debunked this claim in its various forms since at least 2023. The evidence consistently shows that no such free recharge scheme exists. These messages, often accompanied by links or AI-generated videos, are identified as scams intended to collect users' personal information.
